name: Commerce Better Product Variation Label
description: Improves Drupal Commerce product variation labels/titles by optionally prefixing a variation's label with its parent product's label (per variation type); also provides a :label token for commerce_product_variation.
project_description:
This module aims to improve Commerce Product Variation label() results. For details, see features below. 

 It's based on the discussion at [#3083745]

 Features 
 1. Prefix product variation label by product label 
 Prefixes the product variation label by the parent product label (for selected product variation types TBI)

 Other improvements or methods might be implemented in the future. Feel free to contribute!

 Label token 
 The module orovides a :label token for commerce_product_variation to use the generated label instead of the :title token, if needed.
